title: Silent Revision: Measuring Undisclosed Change in the Safety Frameworks of Frontier AI Developers
abstract: arXiv:2609.08789v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Frontier AI developers publish safety frameworks that commit them to evidencing whether their models are dangerous. The European Union and California now treat these documents as instruments of accountability, and both already impose duties on their revision. Neither requires the revision to be legible, in the sense that a reader could learn from the developer's own account what changed. We introduce the silent revision rate, the share of material changes to a framework's commitments that the developer's published account does not identify, and we release the versioned, hash-pinned corpus needed to compute it. The corpus contains every public version of the safety frameworks of the twelve developers that have published one, together with each provider's changelog, redline or announcement. We trace 710 commitment instances across twelve consecutive version pairs, code them against a frozen codebook, and adjudicate 244 individually. Thre

translated_title: 静默修订：测量前沿AI开发者安全框架中未披露的变更
translated_abstract: 前沿AI开发者发布安全框架，承诺证明其模型是否危险。欧盟和加利福尼亚州现在将这些文件视为问责工具，并且两者都已对框架的修订施加了义务。但两者都不要求修订是清晰可读的——即读者能够从开发者自己的说明中了解发生了什么变化。我们引入了“静默修订率”这一指标，即框架承诺的实质性变更中开发者发布的说明未指明的部分所占比例，并发布了计算该指标所需的版本化、哈希固定的语料库。该语料库包含已发布安全框架的十二家开发者的所有公开版本，以及每个提供商的更新日志、红线标注或公告。我们追踪了十二个连续版本对中的710个承诺实例，根据冻结的编码手册对其进行编码，并逐个裁决了其中244个案例。
tldr: 本文提出“静默修订率”指标，用于量化前沿AI开发者安全框架修订中未公开披露的实质性变更比例，并发布了包含十二家开发者安全框架全部公开版本的语料库以支撑该测量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "silent revision rate" to measure the share of material changes in frontier AI developers' safety frameworks that go undisclosed in their published accounts, and releases a versioned, hash-pinned corpus of all public versions of twelve developers' safety frameworks to compute this metric.
